statement: Version 4 registered in C24 after the version 3 cold-start measurement failed because it timed macOS's one-time assessment of the bundled Harness engine (retained: evidence/C24/perf-v3-over-budget-20261023.json; diagnosis: evidence/C24/perf-diagnosis.md). Limits are unchanged; only the cold-start method changed. Measurement records must name this hash and start after this time. The change needs owner or independent reviewer acknowledgement (C24's review is asked for it).
